subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘SHARE’ is written as ‘TJDVJ’, and ‘TOTAL’ is written as ‘UQWEQ’. How will ‘SMOKE’ be written in that language?
solution:
The positional value table is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/889ff2be8a048327f450a975a401b2f4241e5f28d86896613386ad4014cb4505.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

 
• In SHARE → TJDVJ

 
 
• ​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bddfd22eaa77756ce1dd0eea8f1b13c96c05bdf33bb37de4684b19c4c58c501a.png] 
 
 

 

 
• In TOTAL → UQWEQ ​
 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3f03756d3540b0c07c43b01a1f639ed21bbdf8b30ec08c725f05c84f92841107.png] 
 
 

 

 
• Similarly, In SMOKE → ​

 
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91d1965206ed93d4303c18195dc2d91e48b4949c10631149d3f8b0c8833e5b1e.png] 
 
• We get 'TOROJ'.
 
 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
